reviewedRevision: 309f50d plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-level shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. Its one MEDIUM finding (the countdown panel) was fixed and verified by an overlap test, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: The reviewer's own planner bot, reading only public state, cleared all 20 levels at 30, 60 and 120 Hz on 6 seeds and at 60 Hz on 12, and cleared 80 of 80 runs with a 0.4 s reaction, including when it first looked at the board only after the countdown. Straight, random-turn, spiral and zigzag policies won 0 of 108 runs on levels 3-20. 150 fuzz runs with hostile dt, pointers and progress stores threw nothing and every terminal run ended exactly once; recorded runs replayed identically at 30, 60 and 120 Hz; every EN/ZH tip matched the level data.

findings.observation: Only 3 levels built from about 23 per-level branches, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven levels (teaching 1-7, combination 8-14, mastery 15-20) with stones, gates on 4-, 3- and 2-move clocks, tunnels, queued turns and Focus, each with an authored start, an accurate EN/ZH tip, a level select and env.progress continue.
Every level opens with a countdown (4 s on level 1, 2.4 s elsewhere) during which turns can be queued, and the 800-line file is split into seven modules with a quality test file.

Review finding: the countdown panel covered board rows 10-13 at 94% opacity, hiding the head on 8 levels and the first fruit on level 7. The panel now moves to the top or middle when the snake, the cells ahead or the first fruit are low, and a test checks every level; level 20's snake is one cell shorter so it starts with 3 free cells ahead.

openNotes: Level 20's opening is tight: a player who reads the board only at the end of the countdown needs about a 0.4 s reaction.
Some fruit on Needle and Four Rooms sit one cell from the edge and need a planned approach.
The bots plan with the whole board in view, which is more than a human sees at a glance.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, Play again and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: Chinese: Start opened level 1 of 20 (草地) with the countdown panel below the snake and fruit, which stayed visible.
Chinese loss: an Up turn steered into a stone block and the loss screen explained it (第1关：花园障碍格挡住了路线。).

Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the Down touch button queued a turn during the countdown, shown in the HUD, and the snake turned down when play began; after the loss, Play again restarted level 1.
Not covered in the browser: a level win and the level select, which appears only after a first clear; the reviewer's bots and the quality tests cover both.
